title: Add integration with Diabetes: M
body:
I have tried a wide variety of applications for diabetes management. Until I found this one that, to my taste, is the most complete. 

Currently it has integration with Nightscout, but this integration does not work very well and in occasions when there is no connection, it would be good to have a direct connection.

Luckily, they provide a library for Android. 

https://www.diabetes-m.com/blog/news/you-can-now-scan-and-send-data-from-freestyle-libre-or-nightscout-to-diabetesm/

https://github.com/sirmamedical/diabetes-m-addon-example

comments.body:
This is nowhere near the strength of a dedicated integration by any means, but I wrote a cronjob script that runs every 15 minutes to manually sync data between Diabetes-M and Nightscout. The official Diabetes-M integration with Nightscout actually functions as an import of Nightscout data into D-M, which for my purposes I found extremely annoying (BG entries every 15 minutes clogs up the display in the app). I instead export the D-M data, specifically the comment field where I enter meal info and the number of carbs/amount of insulin, and it adds it to the Nightscout database. xDrip doesn't automatically sync this, unfortunately -- you can manually sync it I believe with a backfill -- but for me it works okay.  

The code is a little bare, but maybe it will help someone out: https://github.com/jwoglom/dm2nsc
